LanguageData.MST.destroyOnBombDamageThresholdComment: Explosion damage threshold to destroy this terrain. -1 means immune to bomb/explosion destruction.
LanguageData.MST.modeComment: Normal = driven by sun and air; Fixed = constant; Capped = clamped to the range. Only shown when Atmosphere Overhaul is loaded and the terrain has its extension.
LanguageData.MST.aoTerrainConfigComment: Atmosphere Overhaul's terrain extension: temperature mode, fixed temperature, temperature range, albedo, thermal rate. The resolve cache is cleared on write, so ground temperature updates without a restart.
LanguageData.MST.fixedTemperatureComment: Ground temperature (C) in Fixed mode. Ignored when the mode is Normal or Capped.
LanguageData.MST.minTemperatureComment: Lower bound (C) in Capped mode. AO swaps the bounds if you enter them backwards.
LanguageData.MST.maxTemperatureComment: Upper bound (C) in Capped mode. AO swaps the bounds if you enter them backwards.
LanguageData.MST.aoTerrainNote: Empty albedo / thermal rate = the value AO derives from the terrain type. AO caches the resolved ground material, and this mod clears that cache after a write, so the new value takes effect immediately.
